title: Changing a rule that blocks a requested task
intro: You want the skill to tell you when a skill rule blocks your goal and ask whether its behavior should change. One point remains: the desired change could be a one-time exception for this task or a permanent update to the skill's rule.
coverage: Skill explanation, proactive improvement and change-scope clear; rule-conflict handling needs one distinction

questions.text: When a skill-maintained rule blocks what you asked for, what should the skill ask?

options.label: Explain the exact rule and its impact, then ask whether you want a one-time exception for this task or a permanent change to the skill rule
Assume a one-time exception unless I ask for a permanent change
Ask only whether to change the rule permanently; never offer a one-time exception

questions.why: It makes the effect of your answer clear and avoids silently changing a general preference for one task.

q1.note: Explain the specific rule and its effect, then ask whether I want a one-time exception or a permanent rule change.
